organization.name: Siemens
organization.short_description:
Siemens AG is a leading German multinational technology company based in Munich and Berlin. Founded in 1847, it has grown to become the largest engineering firm in Europe and a global leader in industrial AI, automation, and industrial software. With approximately 318,000 employees, Siemens generated €78.9 billion in revenue in fiscal 2025. The company operates across various sectors, including electrification, automation, and digitalization.

Siemens focuses on four main business segments: Digital Industries, which enhances factory efficiency through automation and software; Smart Infrastructure, providing building automation and energy technology; Mobility, offering smart solutions for transport; and Siemens Healthineers, a major player in medical technology. The company designs and manufactures a wide range of products, including industrial automation systems, energy management solutions, rail vehicles, and medical imaging systems. Siemens serves diverse industries such as energy, healthcare, manufacturing, and transportation, with a global customer base spanning nearly 200 countries.
